text:
From what I understand, Israel is usually pretty lenient about letting people leave with one parent, but other countries may be much more strict. So it depends a bit on where you are travelling. 

In any case, having a signed letter in English from the other parent is good - saying something like "I acknowledge that my child is traveling outside the country with [adult name] with my permission", plus things like the full name, address, and contact information of the accompanying adult and their relationship to the child, information on where you are travelling and the duration of the trip, including specific travel dates etc. 

Having this letter witnessed by a lawyer/notary is even better and may be necessary for some countries.
